description: Send the QA Engineer to walk every screen of the company's product and record its main flows, on the founder's paired computer (or, for a public website with no computer online, Autopo's cloud browser with `cloud: true`). It opens screens, tabs and menus only, never pays, sends, deletes or submits, and stops for the founder at a sign-in wall. Up to 80 screens and about 40 minutes per surface a run. `surface_ids` picks surfaces (every surface when left out); `only`: changed (just the screens changed since the last deploy), more (continue past the cap), problems (try the screens that failed again). You confirm in a dialog first; the agent's time is billed like any task. product_map shows the screens as they come in.

cloud.description: map public web pages from Autopo's cloud browser when no paired computer is online (it never signs in)

company.description: the company id (list_companies); not needed when you have one company, asked for otherwise

only.description: changed | more | problems; a full map when left out

surface_ids.description: the surfaces to map (product_map lists them); all when left out

name: start_product_map
title: Map the product
